page.title: Ledger
page.subtitle: All recorded transactions
page.empty: No transactions found. Click "New Entry" to add one.

row.feeTitle: Evidenced fee linked to this invoice/bill
row.settlesTitle: Settles this invoice/bill — don't add a manual duplicate
row.notMatchedTitle: Not matched to any invoice yet — link it from the Invoices page
row.onStatementTitle: Matched to a bank statement line

rowActions.confirmDelete: Delete this entry? A transfer deletes both sides.

postThrough.label: Post reviewed entries through
postThrough.confirm: Post every reviewed entry dated up to {date}? Posted entries are locked — corrections then go through a reversal.
postThrough.done: {count, plural, one {# entry posted} other {# entries posted}}

status.reversalOf: This reversal cancels <link>{label}</link>. It is posted and can't change.
status.reversedBy: Posted, then reversed by <link>{label}</link> — it no longer counts.
status.draft: Draft — waiting for the owner's review. Not counted in balances or reports yet.
status.reviewed: Reviewed — counted in balances and reports. Posting locks it for the accountant.
status.posted: Posted — locked. Evidence and tax review can still be updated; to change anything else, reverse it and enter the correction.
status.confirmPost: Post this entry? It will be locked; corrections then go through a reversal.

reverse.title: Reverse a posted entry
reverse.body: A posted reversal cancels this entry in full; both stay on record. Its bank match and invoice links are released so the corrected entry — which you enter next — can take them.

new.title: New Entry
new.subtitle: Log a new income or expense transaction

history.title: History
history.empty: No changes recorded since history began (4 Oct 2026).

form.fromBankLine: From bank line {label} — saving matches this entry to it.
form.fromCostItem: From the cost register: {label} — saving adds it to the ledger once, with its receipt.
form.correcting: Correcting {label}, which has been reversed — enter the right values. Saving records this as its correction.
form.accountPlaceholder: Choose the account the money moved through
form.accountHint: Bank, company cash, or Owner-paid if you paid it personally.
form.vndPlaceholder: VND exactly as on the bank statement
form.rateBankHint: Most accurate — the rate is worked out from what the bank actually settled.
form.rateManualHint: Use the rate on the receipt or the bank's rate for that day.
form.rateDefaultHint: Only an estimate — switch to the bank figure when you have the statement.
form.projectHint: Tag this entry to a project for per-project profit.
form.vendorHint: Who you paid — for spend-per-vendor tracking.
form.confirmRemoveReceipt: Remove this receipt? This deletes the file.
form.fileTypes: PNG, JPG, PDF, ZIP (e.g. original e-invoice) — up to 10 MB per save
form.reviewHintExpense: Kept apart from the books: recording an expense never makes it deductible or its VAT claimable — each stays pending until reviewed.
form.reviewHintIncome: Kept apart from the books: a payment received doesn't establish its invoice.
form.reviewNotePlaceholder: Purpose evidence, the accountant's basis, open questions
form.ownerDecides: Business purpose, CIT and VAT are recorded by the owner after the accountant's review.

errors.amountDate: Enter a valid amount and date.
errors.chooseAccount: Choose the account the money moved through.
errors.usdAccount: {name} is a USD account — enter the amount in USD.
errors.registerItemExpense: A register item becomes an expense.
errors.correctionNeedsReversal: Only a reversed entry can be re-entered as a correction.
errors.registerItemTaken: That register item is already in the ledger or dismissed.
errors.editOnAccounts: Edit transfers, capital and loans on the Accounts page.
errors.reversedLocked: A reversed entry and its reversal can't change.
errors.settlesInvoice: This entry settles an invoice — unlink it on the Invoices page before changing its amount, currency or type.
errors.bankLineMatched: This entry is matched to a bank statement line. {problem} Unmatch it on the Bank page first.
errors.postThroughDate: Choose the date to post through.
errors.reasonRequired: Give the reason for the correction.
errors.onlyPostedReversed: Only posted entries are reversed — change drafts and reviewed entries directly.
errors.alreadyReversed: This entry has already been reversed.
errors.attachmentPosted: This entry is posted — its attachments are kept.
errors.attachmentCostItem: This receipt belongs to a cost register item — it stays with the expense.
errors.attachmentFeeEvidence: This is the evidence for a fee on an invoice — unlink the fee first.
errors.attachmentOwnerOnly: Only the owner can remove this document.
